scope: New SHD controlled mechanistic cohort; no resumption of the old 374-job campaign

data.binning: Pinned _bin_h5 at 48 bins; out-of-window events clipped exactly as in the earlier protocol; 12-bin counts are sums of groups of four.

input_timing: Counts injected at the right edge of their physical bin; changing N inserts zero-input network updates but preserves nonzero input values and injection times exactly.
readout: Final-layer spikes sampled at the same 48 physical anchor times and averaged over exactly 48 samples in all cells; N96 uses indices 1,3,...,95. N48 is the original VerticalNet forward.
clock_scope: Fixed discrete neuron coefficients. N changes state-transition/reset/bias applications and hence effective physical dynamics intentionally. This is not a continuous-time-invariant numerical integrator experiment.
shuffle_control: One deterministic label-free time permutation for each sample and four-bin block, shared across channels and all training seeds. Preserves each block count, each feature count-value multiset and channel simultaneity; disrupts fine ordering without coarsening amplitudes.
initialization: Canonical private CPU generator initializes affine weights identically across model families within each seed. Same full initial state and thresholds across the five cells of a model/seed.
calibration: Calibrate each model/seed once on first 128 training examples in fine48_N48; clone thresholds to all five cells. No per-cell recalibration.
minibatches: Private CPU generator seeded 1000000+seed+10000*epoch creates exact same permutation across models/cells; global RNG and construction cannot change it. No dropped samples.
selection: Full validation every epoch; strict >1e-4 improvement in last-five mean; patience20; cap200. Test evaluated only after selection; full selected weights and thresholds replayed twice.

analysis.correction: Holm across ten primary paired t contrasts; report all effects and 95% t intervals. Small-n assumptions disclosed.
analysis.secondary: Within-model effects and interaction reported descriptively. No winner/configuration selection on test. No equivalence conclusion from this SHD study.
analysis.primary_driver: Only report a dominant factor if conditional effects and uncertainty support it; retain interaction and inconclusive outcomes. Completed control design does not guarantee a decisive ranking.

old_results: Old SHD runs remain contextual; no pooling with this changed control/readout/RNG protocol.
training_gate: Every worker must pass source/data/transform/forward/gradient/RNG/resume/selection checks in actual GPU environment; time-budget approval also required before scientific training.
